content.title: Is ‘The Bachelorette’ on TV tonight? Here’s the latest on the franchise’s uncertain future
content.text: Updated: Mar. 22, 2026, 3:35 p.m.Published: Mar. 22, 2026, 3:35 p.m.“The Bachelorette” Season 22 was originally supposed to air Sundays on ABC, starting March 22.ABCIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Madison Kemeny | MKemeny@syracuse.comABC has decided not to move forward with airing Taylor Frankie Paul’s season of “The Bachelorette,” which had been scheduled to premiere this Sunday, March 22. The cancellation was announced on Thursday, leaving the show’s future unclear.What happened to ‘The Bachelorette’ Season 22?ABC’s decision to pull the new season came after reporting of an alleged domestic assault investigation involving “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives” star and her ex, Dakota Mortensen. That announcement coincided with the release of a 2023 video showing an earlier incident between the former couple.Following the video’s release, Disney Entertainment Television issued a statement, saying, “In light of the newly released video that just surfaced today, we have made the decision to not move forward with the new season of ‘The Bachelorette’ at this time, and our focus is on supporting the family.”Will this affect ‘The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives’?Less than a week following the Season 4 premiere on Hulu, filming for Season 5 of “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives” has also been halted amid the recent alleged domestic assault investigation.Although filming has stopped for now, viewers can still watch the first four seasons of “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives” on Hulu. Right now, new and eligible returning subscribers can sign up for the Disney+ and Hulu bundle (With Ads) for just $4.99/month for the first three months, compared to the regular $12.99/month pricing during a limited-time promotion.Disney+, Hulu Bundle$12.99 $4.99Get Disney+, Hulu Bundle for the limited-time offer price of $4.99/month for 3 months.Claim OfferWhat will ABC air instead?Since “The Bachelorette” Season 22 will not be airing, ABC will broadcast a rerun of “American Idol” Season 24, Episode 8 in its place.Viewers still hoping to watch ABC live for free can do so through streaming services such as DIRECTV or Fubo, both of which offer five‑day free trials and carry ABC in select markets.Paul’s “Before the First Rose” special, which aired ahead of her “Bachelorette” season, remains streaming on both Hulu and Fubo as well.Will Taylor’s season ever air?Aside from the single statement given by Disney Entertainment Television, little is known about the future of “The Bachelorette.” While the statement’s wording, “at this time,” and the substantial financial investment leave the door open for a future airing, for now, the season remains indefinitely paused.Previous seasons of “The Bachelorette” are streaming on Hulu.‘The Real Housewives of Rhode Island’ premieres tonight: How to watch for freeNew evidence in John Wilkes Booth case to be revealed on ‘Expedition Files’ Season 4 tonightNew ‘Survivor 50′ Episode 6 airs tonight: Where to watch for free‘The Valley’ returns for Season 3 premiere tonight: How to watch for freeHow to secure Lily Allen presale tickets for fall tour dates before they sell outMadison Kemeny is a Commerce Reporter for syracuse.com | The Post-Standard, covering all things streaming and live entertainment.
